name: Measurement, monitoring and verification (4D seismic, DAS, satellite InSAR)
principle: MMV tracks injected CO2 and checks containment: time-lapse (4D) seismic and VSP image the plume, fibre-optic DAS and DTS give continuous well data, InSAR measures ground displacement, and soil gas and groundwater sampling check the surface. Quest (Alberta) injects about 1 Mt/yr with a 27 Mt target and has recorded no microseismic event indicating loss of containment.

performance.basis: total target 27 Mt; MMV plan revised every 3 years

source.note: Lawton et al., CCUS monitoring, measurement and verification (Alberta Innovates)

performance.metric: minimum detectable atmospheric CO2 release, single CRDS monitoring station
performance.basis: statistical model of background CO2 built on four years of cavity ring-down spectroscopy data (Wilson et al. 2014): 22 t/d for a 100 m x 100 m area source and 14 t/d for a point source about 1 km from a single station, with a high alarm rate (56 percent); the manual concludes single-station atmospheric monitoring is better suited to quantifying an identified release than kilometre-scale release detection over vegetated regions; no cost figures for monitoring methods are given in the manual

source.note: DOE/NETL Best Practices: Monitoring, Verification and Accounting of CO2 Stored in Geologic Formations, 2017 rev., Section 3.1.3.1 Optical Sensors, pp. 28-29

performance.metric: microseismic detection threshold, Cranfield six-well array
performance.basis: no microseismicity was detected at the Cranfield site, with a calculated detection threshold of magnitude 0 and local pressure elevation of about 1,000 psi above hydrostatic; the manual states gravity-method CO2 detection thresholds are site-specific, with deeper reservoirs less suitable for gravity monitoring

source.note: DOE/NETL Best Practices: Monitoring, Verification and Accounting of CO2 Stored in Geologic Formations, 2017 rev., Section 3.3.2.4 Seismic Geophysical Methods, p. 59

costs.metric: 3D seismic survey cost (NETL storage cost model input)
costs.basis: NETL storage cost model parameter for 3D seismic monitoring across project phases: 60,000 (low-cost scenario), 67,000 (base), 80,000 (high-cost) 2008$/mi2; the only per-method monitoring cost stated in the NETL corpus documents read

source.note: QGESS: Carbon Dioxide Transport and Storage Costs in NETL Studies, DOE/NETL-2024/4852, July 2024, Exhibit 2-9 (p. 24)

limitations: The paper does not give detection thresholds or costs
